name: Fable Unconstrained
strategy: Defensive risk-premia harvest: long contrarian value/mean-reversion (gold pullback, Brazil carry, UNH, Berkshire, staples) + volatility-risk-premium via SVXY, 32% cash at 4%
novelty: The return drivers are carry and mean-reversion, not trend: paid for holding assets others just dumped, for multi-year valuation reversion in quality laggards, for the volatility risk premium (short-vol via SVXY), and for cash yield. R1/R2 bought recent winners; this book systematically owns recent losers and premia, zero AI-infrastructure, zero momentum, no crypto.

positions.thesis: Gold -16% in 3m after blowoff top; central-bank bid intact, overshoot mean reversion
Brazil: single-digit P/E, ~8% dividend carry, rate-cut cycle, bought on a -13% 3m pullback
Quality value ballast: flat 2 years while SPY +39%, record cash pile
Multi-year valuation reversion: ~34% below 2024 peak, franchise intact
Staples laggard: cheap defensive carry with upside if the melt-up breaks
Volatility risk premium: harvest VIX contango at VIX~16; 40% stop caps spike risk

backtest.notes: Positive in all 4 windows incl. both stress windows, worst 6m drawdown -9.3%. Honestly rejected: SPY short/RSP spread (bled every window), TLT duration carry (negative every window), tight stops (locked bottoms), naive bottom-3 loser rule. Book will lag SPY in a continued melt-up by design.

outlook: With SPY at highs, VIX ~16 and leadership concentrated, a book paid by carry, cash yield and reversion should compound steadily; expect +4-8% absolute with single-digit drawdown.
